meta.name: generate
meta.description: Phase 2 of the prd-taskmaster pipeline: spec generation and task parsing. Loads a template (comprehensive|minimal), fills it with DISCOVER-phase constraints and answers, validates the spec (placeholders_found, grade thresholds), parses the PRD into tasks via task-master, runs TaskMaster's native complexity analysis, and expands every task into verifiable subtasks. Autonomous-safe. Declares GENERATE complete so HANDOFF can follow.
